tier_should.rationale: Innovative nationwide Twitter RCT isolates celebrity endorsement from reach via retweet-chain design. Massive scale, strong internal validity, clear diffusion effects; belief changes modest. Substantive contribution to networks and development; ideal for top field.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors, NBER visibility, policy relevance, and unique data raise acceptance odds. Even with modest belief effects, diffusion findings are timely; realistic shot at A-journal, otherwise top field.
